title: Peer
description: A person, organization, agent, or other entity the user has an ongoing relationship with. Honcho-style evolving profile — per-peer relationship strength, last interaction, ongoing topics, traits, communication patterns.

relationship_strength.description: 0=barely-known, 1=daily-interaction. Auto-computed by the peer-profile-update sleep pass; user may override (frontmatter wins on next save).

ongoing_topics.description: Aggregated from entity-mentions + recent meeting/customer-typed notes by the sleep-pass.

traits.description: Personality / communication-style traits — free-form, agent or user authored.

linked_entity_id.description: Optional FK into the entities table. Set automatically when the peer-note was created from an entity via /api/peers/from-entity.

communication_history_summary.description: Short prose summary, may be auto-generated by future sleep-pass extension.

privacy.description: Privacy tier for AI operations. 'local-only' forces local LLM provider regardless of user settings; 'default' follows global privacyTier setting.
